newsitem.title: USA: Stryker Q1 net climbs on sales increase.
newsitem.headline: Stryker Q1 net climbs on sales increase.

text.p: Stryker Corp said Monday higher sales domestically and internationally helped earnings in the first quarter ended March 31 post a double-digit percentage gain from year-ago results.
The company, which develops and markets specialty surgical and medical products, reported net income of $30.0 million, or $0.31 a share, versus $25.0 million, or $0.26, a year ago.
Sales climbed to $239.5 million from $217.6 million in the first quarter of 1996, Stryker said.
Stryker said shipments of orthopaedic implants, powered surgical instruments and endoscopic equipment were all higher compared to a year ago.
Stryker shares were up 1-1/16 Monday at 28-7/16.
